propositions: Eval harnesses hard-code repository paths under docs/experiments/ instead of accepting configurable corpus roots, blocking client projects from running plan replay, fixture mining, and provider parity against their own criteria files.
The evals extra is unregistered and 13 MB of research artefacts live in docs/ instead of being excluded from distributions and movable to a top-level evals/ directory.

rebar.llm.config.evals_corpus_root() must be the single authority for resolving replay cache, output, ledger, and project eval-spec roots, with docs/experiments referenced only in plan_replay/corpus.py docstring and only until corpus move lands.
The research corpus tree docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/ must be relocated to top-level evals/ with rebar.toml corpus_root configuration, and excluded from wheel and sdist distributions.
